Jab Ammi guest room ka sofa plastic se nikal dein aur aap uspe baithne se darein ke kahin daagh na lag jaye.
Jab aapka chota bhai phone par aisi awaz mein baat kare ke apko shaq ho ke wo kisi khufia agency ka chief hai, lekin asal mein wo apni class ki kisi larki ko homework ke notes bhej raha ho.

Jab aap ghar ke akele member hon aur bahar gate par bell baje, toh aapko lagta hai ke aap FBI ke undercover agent hain aur aapko chupke se rreng kar window se dekhna parta hai ke Ammi aayi hain ya koi unchaha rishtedaar.
